title: Weighted isoperimetry implies percolation
summary: Consider an infinite edge-weighted graph satisfying an isoperimetric inequality of the type $\|\partial A\|\geq C|A|^α$ for some $α,C>0$, where $\|\partial A\|$ denotes the weighted size of the edge boundary of $A$. We prove that, for $C$ large enough depending on $α$, if each edge is open independently with probability given by its weight, then any vertex is connected to infinity with positive probability. The result also holds under weaker isoperimetric assumptions and on finite graphs. The proof brings a new perspective on the recent proof of the Benjamini--Schramm conjecture concerning…
